name: git-on-path
label: Git
description: git is on the PATH and runnable.

commands.darwin: if xcode-select --install 2>/dev/null; then sleep 2; open "/System/Library/CoreServices/Install Command Line Developer Tools.app" 2>/dev/null; fi; until d="$(xcode-select -p 2>/dev/null)" && [ -x "$d/usr/bin/git" ]; do sleep 5; done
commands.win32: $env:Path += ';' + [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path','Machine') + ';' + [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path','User') + ';' + $env:LOCALAPPDATA + '\Microsoft\WindowsApps'; $base = @('install','--id','Git.MinGit','-e','--silent','--accept-package-agreements','--accept-source-agreements','--disable-interactivity'); $src = @('--source','winget'); $scp = @(); $srcErr = @(-1978335138,-1978335210,-1978335163,-1978335157); winget @base @src @scp; $c = $LASTEXITCODE; if ($srcErr -contains $c) { $src = @(); winget @base @src @scp; $c = $LASTEXITCODE }; if ($c -eq -1978335189) { winget uninstall --id Git.MinGit -e --silent --disable-interactivity @src; winget @base @src @scp; $c = $LASTEXITCODE }; if ($null -eq $c) { exit 1 }; exit $c

exe_data.prompt: Install Git on this machine (https://git-scm.com/downloads). On Windows do NOT run the Git for Windows installer: it asks for administrator rights. Use the portable MinGit zip instead (see the setup notes), which needs none.
